title: NAFEMS LE1: elliptic membrane (plane stress)
description:
NAFEMS benchmark LE1, elliptic membrane (linear elastic, plane stress, static).
Geometry (metres; the STEP file holds this quarter in the plane z = 0): a flat plate of thickness 0.1 m whose plan is the quarter (x >= 0, y >= 0) of an elliptic annulus. Inner boundary: the ellipse (x/2.0)^2 + (y/1.0)^2 = 1, from A = (0, 1.0) to D = (2.0, 0). Outer boundary: the ellipse (x/3.25)^2 + (y/2.75)^2 = 1, from B = (0, 2.75) to C = (3.25, 0). Straight edges AB (on x = 0) and CD (on y = 0) lie on the symmetry planes of the full membrane.
Material: isotropic linear elastic, E = 210 GPa, Poisson's ratio 0.3.
Supports: edge AB (x = 0): zero x-displacement. Edge CD (y = 0): zero y-displacement.
Load: uniform outward (tensile) normal traction of 10 MPa on the outer elliptic edge BC, i.e. the edge is pulled away from the body along its outward normal. The inner elliptic edge DA is traction-free. Plane stress state.
Report: syy_D = direct stress sigma_yy at point D = (2.0, 0.0), in Pa.
